The album was preceded by a sole single, “​bread & butter” in which Gunna cruised the topics of his December 2022 release after which he was claimed a “snitch” due to pleading guilty in the YSL RICO case. Throughout the album, Gunna stays on the topic of being labeled a “snitch” in the industry and being turned on by several rappers who claimed to be his “brother” prior to his release from jail.
